description: This file contains utility functions for file operations such as computing directory size, comparing file contents, reading files, creating directories, and handling file paths within the Chromium project.

methods.name: ComputeDirectorySize
methods.description: Calculates total size of all files within a directory recursively.

methods.name: ContentsEqual
methods.description: Compares two files byte-by-byte to check if they are identical.

methods.name: TextContentsEqual
methods.description: Compares two text files line-by-line, ignoring line ending differences.

methods.name: ReadFileToStringWithMaxSize
methods.description: Reads a file into a string with a maximum size limit.

methods.name: ReadFileToString
methods.description: Reads entire file content into a string.

methods.name: IsDirectoryEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a directory is empty.

methods.name: CreateDirectory
methods.description: Creates a directory at the specified path.

methods.name: GetFileSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of a file.

methods.name: TruncateFile
methods.description: Truncates a file at the current position.

methods.name: GetUniquePathNumber
methods.description: Generates a unique filename by appending a number if the file already exists.
